section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single study (Study X) evaluating the reliability and validity of the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women (N = 228; M age = 19.89). The paper reports construct validity evidence, a unidimensional factor structure, associations between ethnic identity and body appreciation, and mediation by Western beauty ideal internalization for eating/weight/shape concerns.
